description: Two babies appearing in scene - one held by parent and one in crib simultaneously
Multiple children appearing in sleep/bedtime scenes when only one should be present
Crib visible in non-bedroom setting during breastfeeding scene
Mother breastfeeding one baby while second baby visible in crib behind her
Phone screen in scene shows different image than the actual scene around it - avoid phones showing photos
Kitchen has two ovens or duplicate appliances. Kitchens should have realistic, single appliance layouts.
Kitchen or room layout changes between slides in the same carousel. Maintain the same room, furniture placement, and layout throughout all slides.
Kitchen and parent appear too disheveled or messy. Keep scenes clean, warm, and inviting even when depicting busy parenting moments.
Crib placed in middle of room or floating in unrealistic position. Cribs should always be against a wall in a realistic bedroom layout.
Crib moves between rooms across slides (nursery to parents room). Keep the same room and furniture placement throughout the carousel.
Blackout shades mentioned in slide text but disappear in other slides showing the same room. If a feature is mentioned, it should be visually consistent across all slides showing that room.
Child shown clothed during water play or bath activities. Children doing water play should be in appropriate swimwear or diaper, not fully clothed.
Water appears dirty or murky in play/bath scenes. Water should always appear clean and clear.
